title: Count the Dishes, Not the Cells

scenes.tts: A student images one stretched dish and one unstretched dish. The student scores six hundred cells in each. The difference has a p value below zero point zero zero zero one. How many experiments is that? One. Every cell in the stretched dish shared the same dish, the same pipetting, and the same afternoon. If that dish was odd, all six hundred cells carry the oddity together.
scenes.caption: A student images one stretched dish and one unstretched dish. The student scores 600 cells in each. The difference has a p-value below 0.0001. How many experiments is that? One. Every cell in the stretched dish shared the same dish, the same pipetting, and the same afternoon. If that dish was odd, all 600 cells carry the oddity together.
scenes.visual: Two dishes of 600 cells each, a tiny p-value appears, a question mark asks how many experiments; the answer 1 lands and a shared tint spreads over every cell in the stretched dish.

Every cell in the stretched dish shared the same dish, the same pipetting, and the same afternoon. If that dish was odd, all 600 cells carry the oddity together.

scenes.tts: Here is the rule. The thing you independently assign to a treatment is the experimental unit. It can be a dish, a stretch device, or a mouse. The thing you measure is the observational unit. It can be a cell. N, the sample size, is the number of experimental units. Add a drug to a whole well, and the well is the unit. Measuring more cells adds observational units. It adds no experimental units.
scenes.visual: One dish takes a treatment as a whole and lights green as the experimental unit; cells are blue observational units; the cell count climbs from 200 to 600 while N stays 1.
scenes.narration: Here is the rule. The thing you independently assign to a treatment is the experimental unit. It can be a dish, a stretch device, or a mouse. Measuring more cells adds observational units. It adds no experimental units.

scenes.tts: Here is a made-up data set, invented for teaching. Three independent runs, on different days. Each run has one control dish and one treated dish. Two hundred cells are scored in each dish for E d U. It is a thymidine analogue that cells build into DNA as they replicate it. Now pool the cells. Control is one hundred twenty of six hundred, twenty percent. Treated is one hundred seventy-eight of six hundred, twenty-nine point seven percent. Treat each cell as independent, and the standard error is about two point five points. Then z is about three point nine. It looks decisive.
scenes.caption: Here is a made-up data set, invented for teaching. Three independent runs, on different days. Each run has one control dish and one treated dish. 200 cells are scored in each dish for EdU. It is a thymidine analogue that cells build into DNA as they replicate it. Now pool the cells. Control is 120 of 600, 20 percent. Treated is 178 of 600, 29.7 percent. Treat each cell as independent, and the standard error is about 2.5 points. Then z is about 3.9. It looks decisive.
scenes.visual: Six dishes of 200 dots in three runs; EdU-positive cells light up; all dots flow into two pooled blocks of 600 with 20.0 and 29.7 percent, and a red cells-as-N result appears.

scenes.tts: That analysis counted cells. Now make the dish the unit. Each run pairs its two dishes. The differences are fourteen, two, and thirteen points. The mean is nine point six seven. The spread between runs gives a standard error of three point eight four. That is larger than two point five. The ninety-five percent interval runs from minus six point nine to twenty-six point two points.
scenes.caption: That analysis counted cells. Now make the dish the unit. Each run pairs its two dishes. The differences are 14, 2, and 13 points. The mean is 9.67. The spread between runs gives a standard error of 3.84. That is larger than 2.5. The 95 percent interval runs from minus 6.9 to 26.2 points.
scenes.visual: Each run becomes one paired difference dot on a number line; the mean marker, the narrow red cells-as-N bracket and the wider green runs-as-N bracket, then the 95 percent interval crossing zero.
scenes.narration: That analysis counted cells. Now make the dish the unit. Each run pairs its two dishes. The differences are 14, 2, and 13 points. The mean is 9.67. The spread between runs gives a standard error of 3.84. That is larger than 2.5. The 95 percent interval runs from minus 6.9 to 26.2 points.

scenes.tts: So the effect is suggestive, not shown. The interval runs from a small decrease to a large increase. The p value is about zero point one three. That does not show no effect. Scoring two thousand cells per dish would help only a little. The uncertainty comes mostly from run to run variation. More independent runs would.
scenes.caption: So the effect is suggestive, not shown. The interval runs from a small decrease to a large increase. The p-value is about 0.13. That does not show no effect. scenes.visual: The interval is split at zero into decrease and increase; p about 0.13 is not no effect; a 2,000-cell dish barely changes the run spread; extra run slots are added.

scenes.tts: A super plot shows all this in one figure. Each run's mean is a large symbol, colored by run. The comparison uses the large symbols. Run two stands out at once. It is the run where treatment barely moved the mean. Keep the rule. N is the number of independent runs, not the number of cells.
